en: Changed Claude Desktop and Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags off to end the turn when closed with a question open, instead of continuing without an answer
zh: 变更在第三方提供商上或关闭遥测、功能开关时 Claude Desktop 和 Agent SDK 的 session：在仍有未回答问题的情况下关闭时结束本轮，而不是在无答复的情况下继续
